max-duration.$description: Reduced-motion floor (RATIFIED STRUCTURAL LOCK, launch-non-negotiable per WCAG 2.1 SC 2.3.3): under prefers-reduced-motion, every motion vector clamps to static OR an opacity-only crossfade of at most this duration.

budget.$description: Per-frame work budgets at display cadence (RATIFIED gates, CD5 Decision 4). CI/perf-gate values, not design durations.

frame-240hz.$description: Frame budget at 240Hz (ceiling; no application rAF cap).

inp-max.$description: Core Web Vitals gate: INP ceiling.

cls-max.$description: Core Web Vitals gate: CLS ceiling (transform-only animation rule is the mechanism).

motion.$description: Motion tokens — DTCG 2025.10. CD5 (motion.md) ratifies GATES and STRUCTURAL LOCKS, not design durations: every design-facing duration/easing/amplitude in CD5 carries the 'currently inclined toward' register and is explicitly refinable at W3 — transcribing those as tokens would be invention (CD5 §0 C8 language discipline). What IS ratified and tokenizable: the reduced-motion crossfade cap and the per-frame work budgets. No easing curves, stagger intervals, spring configs, or scroll-scrub parameters exist anywhere in canon (verified sweep 2026-08-18) — GAP filed for W3/CD5 ratification, not synthesized here. No CSS emission (no consumer yet); source-of-truth for DESIGN.md (S3) and the perf gates (S1/A4).
